title: Understanding Feature Scaling
text: Think about how the scale of the features might affect the coefficients in a linear model. Which feature has a larger numerical range, and how might that influence the model's decision?

title: Impact of L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization tends to select features by driving some coefficients to zero. Consider how the scale of the features might affect which coefficient is reduced to zero.

title: Comparing Feature Scales
text: Which feature has a larger numerical range?

hintAnswer: The feature with the larger range is less likely to be reduced to zero.
title: Effect of Larger Numerical Range
text: How does having a larger numerical range affect the feature's coefficient in the presence of L1 regularization?
choices: The feature with the larger range is more likely to be reduced to zero.
